context_diary: The account_lookup function retrieves account data with configurable filters for type (AGENT, USER, ADMIN) and return_fields. It returns structured JSON with status, count, total_matches, and data array. The generate_aggregation_report function computes platform metrics like user counts using metric and filters parameters. Both functions require explicit limit parameters to control result size. When requesting random samples, the system may return arbitrary records from the matching set. Admin accounts typically have predictable identifiers like "admin" with localhost emails in development environments. Always verify exact function names from manuals before execution to avoid "Unknown function" errors.
